Task instruction: Use the left arm to pick up the medium-size cylindrical sauce can, move it near the kitchenpot for cooking food

Task description: Use the left arm to move the medium cylindrical sauce jar with a black lid and white label on the left side of the table and place it on the table near the left side of the central white-lidded pot.

Success criteria: The sauce jar is next to the left side of the pan, roughly aligned with it front to back, upright, and resting on the table rather than suspended; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Open slightly wider than the can and surround opposite middle sides of its white-label region, avoiding the black lid rim and protrusions near the mouth for ample pad contact.
- When approaching beside the pot, leave room for the jar and gripper to clear the pot wall and protruding handle. If reorienting, make small adjustments in an open area away from the pot to avoid brushing it.
- Before release, confirm the can base is supported by the table, then gradually open the gripper, avoiding a tip-over from releasing it while suspended.
